tasks.attachmentHint: Attachments are download-only and never executed or embedded. UTF-8 TXT, MD, CSV, PDF, DOCX and PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP are supported; 16 MiB per file, 64 MiB total. Executables, scripts, HTML and SVG are rejected.
tasks.templateHint: Templates capture a task and its undeleted descendants, including text, labels, schedule, work links, comments and attachments. Completion history is excluded; project and section are cleared. Instantiation creates new IDs and keeps saved dates for you to adjust. Templates are excluded from novel projects.
tasks.statisticsHint: Counts actual unreversed completion events. Parent and child tasks count separately; recurring tasks count each actual completion. Dates use this device time zone; weeks start on Monday.

tasks.importTaskHint: Task import adds records without replacing the library. Copy remaps task, project, label, history, comment, attachment, template and filter references. External work links require confirmation. Device reminder preferences and delivery records are excluded.
tasks.projectSummary: Work-owned tasks: {0}; task attachments: {1}. Schema 3 requires software supporting Schema 3; older Schema 1/2 projects can still be imported.
tasks.remindersOn: Device reminders: enabled. The OS controls whether notifications are displayed.
tasks.calendarHint: Calendar cells use this device time zone. Dragging keeps the task’s wall clock and aligns its local day; nonexistent DST times are rejected.
tasks.cycleMissing: A historical cycle member is missing or was moved out. This cycle cannot be restored automatically. History is retained; adjust the current task manually.
appearance.smoothTypingHint: The caret glides as you type. Turn it off to use the system caret in the text and in every field.
appearance.typewriterHint: Keep the current line near the middle of the editor while typing. Scroll freely to browse; following resumes when you type again.

aiProvider.title: AI services
aiProvider.intro: Set up the AI services New World calls itself. Each profile holds an address, authentication, model and generation settings; make as many as you like and assign them to features below.
aiProvider.presetHint: Start from a provider preset; every field can be changed afterwards:
aiProvider.empty: No AI service profiles yet. Choose New profile to start.
aiProvider.discardCopy: This profile has changes that are not saved yet. They will be lost.
aiProvider.name: Profile name
aiProvider.authPrefixHint: Written before the key, e.g. “Bearer ” (mind the space). Leave empty if not needed.
aiProvider.baseUrlHint: The common prefix of the API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. Changing to another domain requires entering the key again.
aiProvider.keySavedPlaceholder: Saved — leave empty to keep it
aiProvider.keyInMemory: The key is kept in this page only; enter it again after a reload.
aiProvider.keyWillClear: The saved key will be removed when you save.
aiProvider.rememberKey: Remember the key on this device
aiProvider.rememberKeyOff: Off by default: the key stays in this page's memory and must be entered again after a reload.
aiProvider.rememberKeyWarning: When on, the key is stored in this site's storage in this browser. Any script running on this site can read it; don't turn this on on a shared computer.
aiProvider.anthropicDirect: Allow direct browser access to Anthropic
aiProvider.anthropicDirectWarning: The web version has no server in between: the browser sends requests to Anthropic itself, so the key is exposed in the browser where page scripts and extensions could read it. Use a dedicated key with a spending limit, or use the desktop app.
aiProvider.modelHint: Type a model name, or choose Fetch models to read the provider's list.
aiProvider.outputSmall: Replies are capped at {0} tokens (about {1} Chinese characters); polishing or summarizing a whole chapter may be cut off.
aiProvider.outputMissing: The Anthropic protocol needs a maximum output token count, or calls will fail.
aiProvider.contextTokensHint: Long text is split to fit this size.
aiProvider.stream: Stream the reply as it is written
aiProvider.retriesHint: Only for temporary failures before any text arrives; none by default.
aiProvider.pathHint: Overrides the default path. A leading / starts from the domain root; query parameters and {model} are allowed.
aiProvider.pathStreamHint: Gemini streaming requests use this path.
aiProvider.headersHint: Values marked Sensitive are stored like the key and left out of exports.
aiProvider.secretSaved: Saved — leave empty to keep it
aiProvider.extraBodyHint: Merged into every request's JSON; objects merge deeply, arrays are replaced.
aiProvider.extraBodyInvalid: This needs to be a JSON object, e.g. { "max_tokens": 8192 }.
aiProvider.deleteCopy: The profile and its saved keys are deleted; features that use it are turned off.
aiProvider.needNameAndUrl: Enter a profile name and Base URL.
aiProvider.corsTitle: The browser's cross-origin rules seem to have blocked the request. You can:
aiProvider.corsTipEndpoint: Use an endpoint that allows cross-origin (CORS) browser requests;
aiProvider.corsTipProxy: Run your own reverse proxy that forwards requests and adds CORS headers;
aiProvider.corsTipDesktop: Use the New World desktop app, which sends requests itself and is not limited by CORS.
aiProvider.exported: Profiles exported. Keys are not included.
aiProvider.imported: Imported {0} profiles. Enter their keys again.
aiProvider.importUnreadable: This file is not valid JSON.
aiProvider.routingHint: Choose which profile each AI feature uses. Features without their own choice use the default profile.
aiProvider.routingEmpty: Create an AI service profile first, then assign features.
aiProvider.featurePolishHint: Also used to rewrite, expand, shorten and change tone.
aiError.unauthorized: The key is invalid or expired. Check the API key in AI settings.
aiError.forbidden: The provider refused the request. Check the key's permissions and whether the model is available.
aiError.quota: Out of quota: the account balance or plan limit is used up. Top up with the provider or switch profiles.
aiError.rateLimited: Too many requests; the provider is rate limiting. Try again shortly.
aiError.rateLimitedWait: Too many requests; the provider is rate limiting. Try again in about {0} seconds.
aiError.timeout: The AI took too long to reply. Try again, or raise the timeout in settings.
aiError.cors: The browser blocked a cross-origin request; this endpoint doesn't allow direct access from web pages.
aiError.network: Can't reach the AI service. Check the network and the Base URL.
aiError.networkMaybeCors: Can't reach the AI service. It may be the network, or the browser's cross-origin rules.
aiError.httpStatus: The AI service returned an error (HTTP {0}).
aiError.http: The AI service returned an error.
aiError.invalidResponse: The AI service's reply couldn't be read. Check the protocol and paths.
aiError.notConfigured: No AI is set up for this feature yet.
aiError.profileChanged: The AI profile just changed. Please start again.
aiError.invalidConfig: Something in the profile is not valid. Check the settings.
aiError.keychain: The system keychain is unavailable, so the key can't be stored safely.
aiError.storage: AI settings couldn't be read or saved. Try again.
aiError.cacheExpired: The summary cache was cleared, so this result wasn't saved.

aiAccess.setupCopy: Add an AI service profile in settings before using this feature.
aiAccess.disabledTitle: This AI feature is turned off
aiAccess.disabledCopy: It is turned off in Feature assignment. You can pick a profile for it in settings.
aiAccess.consentCopy: The text or chapter you choose will be sent to {0} (profile “{1}”) for processing.
aiAccess.consentRelay: If this is a relay or proxy service, whoever runs it can also see the text you send.

styles.intro: A style is a set of instructions telling the AI how to write. Choose one when polishing, rewriting or continuing, or give each work a default. It imitates the manner only and never copies the source text.

styles.name: Name
styles.summaryHint: One or two sentences on the style as a whole.
